task: Use the left gripper to take the indicated dropper from the source bottle and aspirate reagent once. Keep holding the dropper.
Use the right gripper to pick up the indicated test tube and keep holding it.
Use the dropper held by the left gripper to dispense into the test tube held by the right gripper. Do not aspirate again. Keep holding both objects.
Use the left gripper to return the held dropper directly to the indicated source bottle and release it.
Use the right gripper to place the held test tube into the indicated empty rack slot and release it once supported.
Use the right gripper to place the held test tube at the indicated supported position in the water bath and release it once stable.
Walk backward while keeping the test tube held by the right gripper, then stop.
Walk to the left while keeping the test tube held by the right gripper, then stop.
Walk forward while keeping the test tube held by the right gripper. Stop in front of the indicated beaker, ready to place the tube inside. Keep holding the tube.
